Ep. 5 of the Micelclaw OS Module Tours: Mail.

A self-hosted inbox where the agent does the reading: ask where an order stands and it walks the thread — invoice, payment, customs hold — and hands back every email as a clickable chip. Ask for the reorder and it writes the draft. Never sends. Your mail, your hardware, your send button.

Full tour: https://youtu.be/2tE-EroGaTQ
